'''2007 Texas State Championship Thomas Whaley DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' 21 Inchs of Loving
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
